architectural-decision-records.why: records the data-map-pair travel decision and the asymmetric safe-default design
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0064: untagged-pii + retention-basis travel with optional --map; untagged-pii strict-by-default (empty map flags undeclared PII), retention-basis no-op-by-default; the pair relationship and honest limits
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: made this skill two structural gates travel and enforce the data inventory + retention duties in consumers
compliance-data-lifecycle.what: untagged-pii now forces every PII-looking SQL column into data-map.json (know what data you hold); retention-basis forces each declared entry to carry a lawful basis + retention; both travel via optional --map with safe defaults
quotes: Know what data you hold, why you are allowed to hold it

pattern-selector.why: chose the two safe defaults deliberately against each gate role
pattern-selector.what: selected strict-by-default for untagged-pii (empty map = maximally strict, forces declaration) and no-op-by-default for retention-basis (nothing declared = nothing to check), not a single uniform default; recorded the asymmetry and why in the ADR
quotes: A pattern removes one specific kind of failure or rot

verifiable-quality-gates.why: every new behavior has a discriminating test proven to detect
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added tests: optional/absent map (retention no-op exit 0; untagged-pii strict exit 1), malformed-present map fail-closed, --allow-empty zero-sql pass, --ignore infra skip, test-fixture skip; extended CONSUMER-TESTS to run both gate tests in a consumer
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: tested at unit level and end-to-end through genesis into a consumer
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: unit tests exercise the optional-map and scope logic for both gates; the genesis path runs the aggregator over all eleven gates clean, then confirms undeclared PII turns untagged-pii red
quotes: Test at the lowest level that can catch the bug

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the gate-script change; the travel behaviors are pinned as executable scenarios
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: behaviors (no-map consumer: retention green + untagged-pii reds undeclared PII; declared PII green; missing basis/retention red; infra+test dirs skipped) are written as discriminating tests at the lowest layer that proves them
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

judge-arch.why: reviewed in fresh context against the four questions before done
judge-arch.what: ran judge-arch on both gate changes, the manifest entries, and the stale-test updates; recorded the matrix in the arch-review log
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion

skeptical-audit.why: each claim carries an evidence state and re-runnable source, disconfirming case first
skeptical-audit.what: proved travel end-to-end in a genesised consumer (11 gates green clean; untagged-pii red on a planted undeclared email) and confirmed the empty-map default is strict (more findings), not fail-open
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

arch-encode.why: no new caught-mistake-to-rule in this change; the --allow-empty/--ignore scan-scope pattern was already established and encoded in ADR-0061/0063

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no system/data architecture or service change; CLI flags + manifest entries on existing gates

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: no auth/input/crypto/session code; PII inventory is a privacy control, covered by compliance-data-lifecycle

release-deployment-safety.why: no deploy/migration/feature flag; manifest version already leads at unreleased 1.2.0

sre-operational-readiness.why: no runtime service, SLI/SLO, or alerting surface

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: no user-facing UI; gate scripts and tests only
